title: Weld Heat Input
subtitle: kJ per mm — controls HAZ hardness, distortion, and hydrogen retention

inputs.label: Arc voltage
inputs.help: Typical: SMAW 20–30, GMAW short-arc 16–22, GMAW spray 26–34, GTAW 8–20, SAW 26–40

inputs.label: Welding current
inputs.help: Read from the machine display or a clamp meter on the work lead

inputs.label: Travel speed
inputs.help: Time a known length of bead. Speed = length ÷ time.

bands.label: Low
bands.note: Fast cooling — may need preheat on higher-carbon or thicker steels

bands.label: Typical
bands.note: Common range for SMAW/GMAW/FCAW on structural steel

bands.label: High
bands.note: Larger HAZ, more distortion — verify WPS allows it

bands.label: Very high
bands.note: Typical of SAW or heavy multi-pass — check WPS max heat input

notes: Some codes (ASME IX, CSA W59) require heat input tracking as an essential variable, especially on quenched-and-tempered or high-strength low-alloy steels. Exceeding the qualified HI range invalidates the WPS.
